page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 345 at top right. Below the head: two parallel columns (left "APVD ETHNICOS", right "APVD PAPISTAS") with a bracketed marginal label "Cortina"/"Robigo" on the left side of the left column. Then a centred heading "O. ANIMALIUM." with subheading "1. Qui Patroni.", two parallel columns; then subheadings "2. Quibus Diis consecrati.", "3. Quibus immolati." and "4. Qui averruncatores." in columns; a bracket labelled "Patron" beside the right side of section 2; a signature "Yf" at the foot.

page.notes: Left margin carries a vertical label "Cortina" and a bracket "Robigo" with the matching bracket beside the Papist column; the bracketed groups in sections 2 and 3 and the "Patron" label are reconstructed from layout and may be imperfect. Several words in the column tops are faint and uncertain (e.g. "rubiginem", "Hippona", "Ovium"). Some marginal ink smudges are not transcribed.
